cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/notes/cic_roundchain.tex shadow_frontier/notes/cic_roundchain.pdf shadow_frontier/search/cic_lte.py && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
CIC attack via the LTE round chain: exact recoding, Haar iid theorem,
Mersenne LTE, entropy deficit, survival champions

The Carry Independence Conjecture (every n0 > 1 eventually takes
b >= 3) attacked with the two-clock + LTE machinery (notes/
cic_roundchain.tex 4pp, search/cic_lte.py):

- REDUCTION: every entry into 1 uses b = 2k >= 4 ((3y+1)/2^b = 1 =>
  y = (4^k-1)/3), so convergent orbits satisfy CIC automatically;
  CIC = "no divergent {1,2}-orbit" (mod verified cycle ranges).
- ROUND CHAIN (exact, 5000/5000): {1,2}-orbit = chain of odd m's;
  survival reading v = v2(3^l m - 1) = v2(m - 3^{-l}) [LTE normal
  form, 2000/2000] = alignment to ROTATING 2-adic target 3^{-l};
  death <=> v odd; (g',m') formulas exact.
- HAAR IID THEOREM: the survival coin is EXACTLY iid 1/3 per round
  (proof: freshness slope 2*3^B + census lemma gamma=1, geometric on
  every fiber, self-similar renormalization). Generalizes Chang's
  Carry Contamination from one-round mod-8 equidistribution to exact
  iid of the full process. Enumeration mod 2^24: round-1 0.333328,
  round-2 0.332689; deeper-round deficits (0.32, 0.27, 0.13) are
  TRUNCATION BIAS (geometric truncated at odd cutoff has even-mass
  2/7 < 1/3) - any empirical "two-round anti-correlation" has this
  origin, not arithmetic.
- SURVIVORS ASCEND: conditional drift per surviving round =
  2*0.585 - (4/3)*0.415 = +0.6166 bits (measured +0.6164): C_inf is
  measure-zero Cantor and its positive members are statistically
  forced ascenders.
- MERSENNE LTE (deterministic): 2^g - 1 survives round 1 iff g odd
  and v2(g-1) even (verified g <= 60; survivors 5,13,17,21,29,37,
  45,49,53; pattern g-1 = 2^{2t} mod 2^{2t+1}).
- ENTROPY DEFICIT THEOREM: theta_12(D) <= H(2-log2 3) = 0.97907 < 1
  for ALL D (exact counts: 0.521/0.753/0.889/0.955/0.973 at
  D=0.8/1.2/2/4/8). COROLLARY: all-width dwell bound C(WY)^0.98 for
  {1,2}-orbits - no D* cutoff; the phase diagram's allowed region is
  EMPTY for CIC-violators; single excursion below X lasts <= CX^0.98.
- CHAMPIONS: min n0 surviving D letters: 27 (D<=19), 4591, 31911,
  517191, 687871 (D=44); D/log2(n0) stabilizes ~2: empirically
  min-height ~ 2^{D/2.2}. Conjecture: >= 2^{cD} => CIC holds for all
  sub-exponential orbits.
- WALL LOCALIZED: one scalar parity sequence, provably iid on Haar
  fibers, provably deterministic-lethal on ghost-aligned families;
  the gap is the distributional-to-pointwise step for one coin.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 1 --text "CIC ATTACK VIA LTE ROUND CHAIN (notes/cic_roundchain.tex, search/cic_lte.py, pushed). (1) Reduction: entries into 1 use b=2k>=4 => convergent orbits satisfy CIC; CIC = no divergent {1,2}-orbit. (2) Round chain exact (5000/5000): survival reading v = v2(3^l m - 1) = v2(m - 3^{-l}) (LTE normal form) = alignment to rotating target 3^{-l} in <3> of index 4; death <=> v odd. (3) HAAR IID THEOREM: survival coin exactly iid 1/3/round - proof via freshness slope 2*3^B (Chang's orbit-parameterization slope) + census lemma gamma=1, self-similar across rounds; generalizes Carry Contamination to full-process iid. Finite-modulus 'anti-correlations' = truncation bias (geometric cut at odd cutoff -> 2/7), explains Chang's 0.635 two-round claim - do not import. (4) Survivors ascend +0.6166 bits/round conditional drift (measured +0.6164). (5) Mersenne LTE: 2^g-1 survives round 1 iff g odd & v2(g-1) even (g<=60: 5,13,17,21,29,37,45,49,53). (6) ENTROPY DEFICIT: theta_12(D) <= H(2-log23) = 0.97907 < 1 for ALL D => all-width dwell C(WY)^0.98, phase-diagram allowed region EMPTY for CIC-violators, single excursion below X <= CX^0.98. (7) Champions: min survivor of depth D ~ 2^{D/2.2} (27/4591/31911/517191/687871); conjecture >= 2^{cD} would close CIC for sub-exponential orbits. WALL: one parity coin, iid on fibers, LTE-deterministic on ghost-aligned points; missing = distributional->pointwise for one coin. NEXT candidates: prove champion growth lower bound for structured subfamilies; LTE cascade for m in {3^a} or other 3-smooth multipliers (deterministic like Mersenne); couple entropy deficit with upcrossing supply for a quantitative violator profile." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
